description: In a world driven by complex challenges and rapid innovation, achieving extraordinary goals is never a solo endeavor. To turn a  visionary idea into reality, one needs more than just hard work-they need a cohesive, high-performing  ecosystem of minds.
summary: Jezero Descent is a browser-based Mars rover descent and surface operations simulation game. Players control a lander during entry, descent, and landing by managing altitude, speed, dynamic pressure, parachute deployment, and fuel. Once on the surface, users navigate the terrain and manage rover systems across Martian days (Sols) by monitoring speed, surface grip, wheel wear, battery power, and solar panel dust. The interface also features environmental telemetry—such as temperature, pressure, dust opacity, and communication uplink delay—alongside action controls to drill, clean, sleep, and brake.
